findings.label: blocking
findings.text: INSS 30-day deadline cited without an article number and not watched by check_laws.
findings.response: Fixed: cites Lei 8.213 art. 73-A (incluído pela Lei 15.415/2026); Lei 15.415 added as a watched source with DOU term.

findings.label: blocking
findings.text: Paternity schedule (Lei 15.371 art. 11) not watched and not verified.
findings.response: Fixed tracking: Lei 15.371 added (arts. 11, 12, 14). Verified: the 10/15/20-day schedule and the fiscal-target condition were quoted verbatim from the Senado's text of the law during research. CLT 392 §8 is inside art. 392, which is fingerprinted.

findings.label: blocking
findings.text: Any crash exits 1 and is filed as a law change; DOU JSON parse outside try.
findings.response: Fixed: changes exit 2, crashes fail the run; DOU parse errors become reported errors. Test added.

findings.label: suggestion
findings.text: Layout break or common DOU mentions would show a warning to every mother.
findings.response: Fixed: law_warning fires only on new amending acts or changed article text.

findings.label: question
findings.text: How does the running bot get laws_status.json?
findings.response: From its checkout; README now says the deployment must git pull. No expiry on purpose: an unreviewed change should keep warning.

findings.label: suggestion
findings.text: --accept with fetch errors records gaps that are never watched.
findings.response: Fixed: --accept refuses (exit 3) unless every source was read; --force overrides. Test added.

findings.label: suggestion
findings.text: Weekly bot commit even when nothing changed; push precedence.
findings.response: Fixed: status file rewritten only when something besides the date changed; explicit if/then for commit+push.

findings.label: suggestion
findings.text: Last-match article heading fragile on pages that quote other laws.
findings.response: Acknowledged, kept: the watched articles on those pages are not quoted elsewhere; a wrong match shows up as a text change for a person to check, not as silence.

findings.label: question
findings.text: Was 394-A III / §3 checked against the Câmara text?
findings.response: Yes: quoted verbatim from the Câmara compiled CLT, including both ADI 5.938 notes on incisos II and III.

findings.label: suggestion
findings.text: Paternity pay attributed to INSS under art. 11; CLT employers pay and are reimbursed (8.213 arts. 73-D/73-E).
findings.response: Fixed, and arts. 73-B to 73-G added to the watch list.

findings.label: suggestion
findings.response: README tells the reader to run the workflow with accept once the sites are back.

findings.label: question
findings.response: Documented as a deployment requirement; there is no production deployment yet.
